product from any number of devices. If you own Device CALs, any user can log on and use the software from any device covered by a CAL. A Device CAL only grants access to one person at a time per device. (For example, if two employees take turns using a laptop covered by a Device CAL, only one of them can log on to the server software at a time.) Device CALs make sense if you have lots of employees sharing a few computers. They can also make sense for services organisations which have a limited number of staff but serve lots of clients on their site using the organisation's computers.
External Connector licenses: When an application is accessed primarily or entirely by external users, such as clients, then an External Connector license is sometimes a more economical way of licensing than CALs. For example, you might want to install Microsoft Dynamics CRM on a Web server so that clients can look up information about their own cases. In this scenario, you could buy an External Connector license, which lets any number of external users access the application. The alternative would be to buy individual client licenses for every client who might want to access your system, which would probably cost much more, even if many of your clients never access your system. COX-2's key feature is its role in the production of prostaglandins, which are involved in pain, fever and inflammation. The SES sponsors a biennial meeting and participates in the organization of conferences and workshops. The society also produces a newsletter and works to increase public awareness and appreciation of soil ecology.

- International Union of Soil Sciences
The International Union of Soil Sciences (IUSS) was founded in 1924. The IUSS is a global union of national societies. The goals of the IUSS are to foster soil science and its application on a global scale, to promote all branches of soil science and the researchers working in the field of soil science, and to put soil scientists in touch with the broader field of environmental science.
The first international conference of Soil Science was convened in Washington D.C., USA in 1927. The organization of the first congress was authorized at the meeting of the International Society of Soil Science in Prague

et' sah' tee) ("divided choirs") is an Italian term for a musical technique employed during the late Renaissance and early Baroque eras (c. 1550-1650). Two or more vocal or instrumental ensembles (usually four or more) were placed in various locations within a performance venue (or a church), often with a conductor in the middle. Each group is called a coro ("choir"). Usually the composer would alternate distinct, clear phrases in different choirs with each phrase in a new choir, sometimes in contrasting cadences and keys. The composer used the technique mainly for antiphonal textures in which choirs answered each other in imitation (polychoral technique). The antiphonal effect in the choirs was called cori spezzati. In modern use the term cori spezzati refers to the antiphonal division of a choir into two or more groups.
In the middle of the sixteenth century, composers from the Venetian school began to write polychoral works. They are among the most important and prominent composers of the late Renaissance, active from around 1550 to around 1610. After California became a state, the new settlers began to seize the indigenous population’s land, while the tribes started to fight for their rights. Over time, European colonists sought to extract themselves from tribal land and to seek a new relationship with the continent. This article examines the port's complex history, from its role in the wool trade to its use in both World Wars, to its more recent role in the post-war immigration boom.
It all started in 1839, when the first cargo of wool was shipped from Port Melbourne to London. By 1854, the port had become the busiest in Australia, with more than 1,500 vessels arriving each year. The wool trade made Port Melbourne a vital link in the global economy, and by the 1880s, the port had expanded to include more than 20 berths.
